categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in tire manufacturing, including bicycle tires, motorcycle tires, industrial vehicle tires, light truck tires, and radial tires. It also engages in the manufacturing of reinforced plastic products, machinery equipment, and international trade. Additionally, the company is involved in wholesale and retail of automotive and bicycle parts and tires.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced tire manufacturing technologies including automated production lines and real-time production monitoring systems. It focuses on sustainable materials, low-carbon and eco-friendly rubber compounds, and smart tire technologies such as intelligent and airless tires. The production process includes rubber mixing, extrusion, tire building, vulcanization, and quality inspection, supported by R&D in dynamic simulation and VOC reduction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and aftermarket distributors in the automotive, motorcycle, and bicycle industries. Major end markets are North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, China, and emerging markets such as Mexico and Vietnam. The company targets high-value segments like electric vehicles and SUV tires, as well as industrial and commercial vehicle sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, Vietnam, Indonesia, China, and sales offices in the US, Europe, and Hong Kong. It serves markets across North America, Europe, Asia, Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and Oceania. The company emphasizes global supply chain flexibility and regional market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the tire supply chain, focusing on tire manufacturing and assembly. It sources raw materials such as natural and synthetic rubber, carbon black, steel wire, and chemicals from upstream suppliers and sells finished tires downstream to OEMs, distributors, and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include tariff risk mitigation, sustainability with carbon reduction targets, and innovation in smart and airless tires. R&D focuses on energy-efficient materials, dynamic tire simulation, VOC reduction, and electric vehicle tire development. The company invests in automation, digitalization, and lifecycle management systems to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of tires and related rubber products. The company also earns income from international trade activities and aftermarket parts distribution. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but emphasizes volume sales combined with high-value product offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major tire manufacturers such as Cheng Shin (Maxxis), NanKang, and global players like Bridgestone and Michelin. It positions itself as a top 30 global tire company with a focus on high-performance, sustainable, and smart tire products, leveraging multi-regional manufacturing to mitigate tariff and trade risks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$34.2 billion with a slight decline of 0.7% year-over-year but improved profitability with a 40.86% increase in net income to NT$1.24 billion. It maintains steady asset growth and equity returns, with ongoing capital expenditures to expand capacity and R&D investments accounting for about 2% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality, innovation, and sustainability as key differentiators. It offers a broad product portfolio including eco-friendly and smart tires tailored for electric vehicles and high-performance applications. Its global manufacturing footprint and flexible supply chain enhance customer responsiveness and tariff risk management, supporting a strong brand presence and customer satisfaction.
